data.body: Closing RCA: the fresh sunfish CI worker crash was caused by test_review_bot.py::test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs carrying a 3s pytest-timeout marker over setup/call/teardown. Cold pydantic_ai import in an autouse fixture under coverage can spend that budget before the TestClient body runs; pytest-timeout thread mode calls os._exit(1), so xdist reports a worker crash on the test. Change 2932 raised that local marker to 30s and added a timeout-budget regression guard while preserving the test's internal <2s lifespan assertion. CI run 34391709788 passed with LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1, then change 2932 merged.
